name: Aizawa Eiichi
source: A friend [url=/c305]Kyousuke[/url] plays around with at school to relieve stress. A bit of an idiot, he acts innocent around others but goes on vulgar, chauvinistic rants when chatting with Kyousuke. He claims he pretends to be cute to reel in girls, but his strong interests in sweets and style are real. He also claims to be an orphan sometimes, but in reality his dad owns a couple really big hotels in the Central Boulevard. He's interested in mature and older women.
